subject: Patho 2
description: Atherosclerosis, angina, myocardial infarction and complications.

questions.text: Which of the following is the earliest serum marker to rise after myocardial infarction and the most specific?
questions.explanation: Cardiac troponins (I and T) rise within 2 to 4 hours, peak around 24 hours and are the most sensitive and specific markers. Myoglobin rises earlier but is nonspecific.

questions.text: Ventricular free wall rupture after myocardial infarction most commonly occurs at which time?
questions.explanation: Rupture occurs 3 to 7 days after MI, when the necrotic myocardium is softest because of macrophage-mediated lysis, before granulation tissue gives strength.
